_comment: HUMAN-OWNED. Research topics for every paper in the bibliography, keyed by DOI (or arxiv:<id> for a paper with no DOI yet). A paper may carry several topics. Read by src/data/allPublications.ts; the build fails if a listed paper has no entry, or an entry names an undefined topic, so a newly synced paper must be placed here before it ships. Agreed with Anna 2026-10-17.
